text:
Alex Chen: FYI I'm seeing a p95 jump on eu-west dedicated warm pools, ~320ms -> ~420ms starting 03:10 UTC. any infra changes? @Morgan

infra-bot: ALERT eu-west-warm-01 p95=420ms (threshold=320ms), nodes affected: 3/12, egress_bytes spike detected

Priya Nair: saw this too. correlated with a tenant doing large batched embeddings (stripe-batch). NIC egress for the host peaked then.
Priya Nair: logs snippet:
```
eth0: tx_bytes=123456789 rx_bytes=987654321
irq: high softirq at 03:09:57
```

Sam Ortiz: we rolled kernel irq-coalescing tweak last night to reduce CPU, could be increasing burstiness for small packets. not sure about NVLINK/KV cache effects though.

Morgan Reyes: rolled that change back at 03:15 but p95 didn't fully recover. my read is kv-cache churn + slab fragmentation for dedicated warm slices. noisy tenant keeps creating many short-lived slots.

Jamie Lutz: cost note: adding more reserved warm slots or pre-warming will raise GPU-h spend in eu-west by ~3-5% if we do it cluster-wide. need ROI vs SLA impact.

Leo Park: Proposal: soft isolation instead of immediate dedicated carveouts — implement nic-policing per-tenant on the pool + egress shaping and clamp batch sizes for non-SLA tenants. do a canary on one warm pool. example tc commands: 
```
# limit egress to 400mbit and prioritize small flows
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 12
tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 400mbit
tc filter add dev eth0 protocol ip parent 1:0 prio 1 u32 match ip dst 0/0 flowid 1:1
```

Priya Nair: :thumbsup: canary on eu-west-warm-02 for 2h sounds good. will tag tenant as noisy_probe and collect per-tenant metrics (egress, kv_cache_hit_rate, p95).

Alex Chen: who can schedule the canary and add dashboards/alerts? want KV cache hit-rate, p95, cpu, egress bytes per tenant and a rollback trigger (p95 back above 380ms or errors>1%).

Morgan Reyes: I can schedule. will start canary 03:40 UTC, 2h window. plan: 1) apply tc policing on eu-west-warm-02; 2) apply batch-size clamp for non-SLA tenants >256 tokens; 3) tag stripe-batch tenant noisy_probe; 4) run load generator for 30m and watch metrics. rollback plan posted below.

Morgan Reyes: Rollback plan:
- If p95 reduction <10% after 30m -> revert tc and clamp immediately
- If errors increase >1% -> revert and demote canary
- Ops alert to #oncall if CPU or GPU thermal rises >5%

ops-bot: Scheduled canary job canary-504321 (eu-west-warm-02) starting 03:40 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/ops/canary/504321

Jamie Lutz: agreed metric threshold for rollout: >15% p95 improvement with <5% cost increase -> roll to other warm pools. otherwise revert and consider per-tenant kv-cache cap + smarter slot reclamation.

Alex Chen: cool. keep updates here during the canary, and tag me if we hit rollback triggers. thanks everyone.
